genericProblem: An implementation-facing remediation design can claim serial closure while its operation population, command-race protocol, source denominator, scanner boundary, or UI decision input remains non-deterministic.

counterexamples.boundary: Valid only with deterministic roots, classification, exclusions, and a red proof.
Integrity alone does not define concurrent recovery or a user-safe typed error.
It must re-freeze the affected implementation-facing unit.

findings.summary: P3-A/P3-B do not freeze a coherent post-R-24 write-operation denominator.
P3-B does not specify receipt insert-race recovery or FK-conflict translation under hidden-reference constraints.
All six manifest denominator fields self-bind to the design summary instead of their declared owning sources.
P4 canonical ledger lacks deterministic scan roots, identity, exclusions, and a production-path insertion red proof.
P6/P3-D required interaction amendments are not yet frozen implementation inputs.
